name: glassmorphism
label: Glassmorphism
css: .style-glassmorphism { position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) 100%); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(24, 86, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 24px; padding: 60px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .style-glassmorphism::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -50%; right: -50%; width: 600px; height: 600px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #1856FF) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.08; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .style-glassmorphism::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -30%; left: -30%; width: 500px; height: 500px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #1856FF) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.05; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .style-glassmorphism .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: #141414; margin-bottom: 20px; position: relative; z-index: 1; letter-spacing: -1px; } .style-glassmorphism .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: #3A344E; position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 90%; } .style-glassmorphism .step { position: absolute; top: 60px; right: 60px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-primary, #1856FF); opacity: 0.08; line-height: 1; z-index: 0; } .style-glassmorphism .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 60px; left: 60px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #141414; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-glassmorphism { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.95) 0%, rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.90) 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(24, 86, 255, 0.25); } .slide-code.style-glassmorphism::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #1856FF) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-glassmorphism .hook { color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-code.style-glassmorphism .text { color: #E0E0E0; } .slide-code.style-glassmorphism .brand { color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-insight.style-glassmorphism { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.97) 0%, rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.95) 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(24, 86, 255, 0.3); } .slide-insight.style-glassmorphism::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #1856FF) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-glassmorphism .hook { color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-insight.style-glassmorphism .text { color: #F5F5F5; } .slide-insight.style-glassmorphism .insight-text { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: #FFFFFF; position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 95%; } .slide-insight.style-glassmorphism .brand { color: #FFFFFF; }
